RATHNAPURA PRADESHIYA SABHA THE Roads and lanes which are deem to be owned by Rathnapura Pradeshiya Sabha in which are relevant notiﬁ cation is included published in the Gazette No. 2411/53 on November 22, 2024 under the terms made by Section 24(1) of Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of 1987. as the “Orders on the preparation of plans and posting of notices showing the list of names of the Roads and lanes” maintained by the Pradeshiya Sabha of Sabaragamuwa Province as the Honourable Governor of Sabaragamuwa Province has publish in the special Gazette No. 2316/20 dated 24 January 2023 and it is hereby published for the public that it has been decided under decision No. 10 of 28th 2025. That all said Road and lanes shall be owned by Rathnapura Pradeshiya Sabha as because of any case has not been assigned in a competent court on the date ﬁ xed by the said notiﬁ cation.

It is further announced that all Roads and Lanes included therein shall be deemed to be Roads and Lanes established by the Rathnapura Pradeshiya Sabha under Sub section (5) of Section 24 of Pradeshiya Sabha Act list of those Road and Lanes is included in the Schedule here.
Secretary and Oﬃ cer Implementing Powers and Functions , Rathnapura Pradeshiya Sabha.
